# Ghost Radio

> Ghost Radio is an audio lab for AI music, half-finished albums, and the open-source React package `@walkswithaswagger/winamp`.

## Public pages

- [Ghost Radio](https://ghost.radio.fm/): The modern audio deck and station tuner
- [Classic Booth](https://ghost.radio.fm/classic): The classic Winamp-style skin showcase

## Open source package

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/WalksWithASwagger/winamp)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@walkswithaswagger/winamp)

## Creative AI Human Lab

Ghost Radio is part of Kris Krüg's Creative AI Human Lab, a linked set of
public films, portals, music, and agent tools.

- [KrisKrug.co Work](https://kriskrug.co/work/)
- [AI Garden](https://kriskrug.ai/)
- [Skywhale Airways](https://skywhaleairways.com/)
- [Punk Rock AI](https://www.punkrockai.com/)
- [Gorgeous Ghost](https://gorgeousghost.com/)
- [Wedges](https://wedges.dev/)
- [Too Weird to Die](https://www.bothhandsfull.com/album/too-weird-to-die)
- [Ethos Lab Block Party](https://ethosblockparty.com/the-day)
